releases.headline: Elevation Health Pairs Registered-Dietitian Support With Physician-Prescribed GLP-1 Care as Research Highlights an Industry-Wide Support Gap
releases.snippet: Elevation Health structures its telehealth GLP-1 program around registered-dietitian support alongside physician prescribing, in response to published 2026 research identifying high discontinuation rates and limited nutritional oversight across the telehealth weight-management sector.

releases.headline: Elevation Health Publishes a Plain Description of Its Consultation Process
releases.snippet: Elevation Health has published a step-by-step description of its telehealth consultation process, including the assessment stage at which a clinician may determine that an applicant is not a candidate.
